calibrationUse: Choose gate only; never modify model weights using these rows.
validationUse: Frozen model and gate. No tuning on validation outcomes.
testOpening: Only after matching validation qualification passes all checks.

acceptance.boundOnlyAblation: AI routed time and bootstrap upper must beat always-on deterministic bound control; do not credit all bound gains to AI.

note: 36 small validation conditions were used for correctness tests, not model or threshold tuning. Evaluation sizes and acceptance rules fixed before external timing outcomes.
